description: Combine the full-grid global leader with the confirmed copy-free n=512 graph path. Import only direct-input stage-0 materialization, physical-upper FP32 diagonal reloads, and compact off-diagonal FP16 sidecars while preserving every non-n=512 specialization, caller-stream ordering, caches, fresh inputs, and the complete benchmark grid; then profile and reduce the remaining distributed factor/solve/update overhead.

Combined the full-grid 6d5995f leader with the copy-free exact batch640 n512 graph path: stage 0 materializes directly from input, factor waves store only physical-upper FP32 diagonals, solves reload those diagonals, and the FP16 sidecar is compacted to 120 off-diagonal tiles, while every non-n512 specialization and caller-stream path remains from the first parent. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Aggregate measured 771.711 us; batch640 n512 measured 1168.864 us mean / 1148.928 best, while an unrelated 5.037-s n256 outlier inflated that cell's mean. Authorized hosted profile request 4e8b5bb67759466cad03bd2862c4870f ran 2026-07-20T22:03:17Z at commit 8e647a2b7a9f0b67538b5efa6bf671fb9d6dfb87 benchmark index 5 and saved brief-93-trial-1-8e647a2b7a9f0b67538b5efa6bf671fb9d6dfb87.ncu-rep; its first captured waves attributed 455.000 us to three update launches, 212.840 us to three solve launches, 42.430 us to three factor launches, and 142.020 us to output initialization.

Replaced paired distributed update CTAs with one CTA per trailing row. Each row CTA loads its common FP16 solved panel once, reuses one LD40 accumulator and one target-factor slot across all row destinations, and reduces stage-0 update blocks from 40,960 to 9,600 while shrinking dynamic shared storage from 12.52 to 10.02 KiB. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch640 n512 regressed from combined Trial0 1168.864 us mean / 1148.928 best to 1193.792 / 1167.296 us, measuring the cost of row-serial MathDx work despite reduced blocks and common-factor traffic. Aggregate measured 764.357 us rather than Trial0's outlier-inflated 771.711 because unrelated n256 sampling was cleaner.

Narrowed row-serial distributed updates to groups of at most four adjacent destinations per CTA. Each 10.02-KiB CTA keeps one common FP16 panel plus one reusable target panel and accumulator, using a scatter-pair first load off the diagonal; stage-0 update blocks become 23,040 versus the original paired path's 40,960 and row-wide path's 9,600. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. A 25.091-ms target outlier inflated batch640 n512 mean to 1261.382 us, while its 1138.656-us clean best improved combined Trial0's 1148.928 by 10.272 us and row-wide Trial1's 1167.296 by 28.640 us. Aggregate measured 757.058 us under cleaner unrelated cells. The exact commit will be repeated to resolve the outlier-heavy mean.

Repeated exact four-destination update commit 567c77825171b887b203333946aafd649ad44118 after Trial2's 25.091-ms target outlier. Fresh slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed after one transparent Modal container restart. Batch640 n512 measured 1162.078 us mean / 1136.640 best, confirming Trial2's 1138.656-us clean floor and improving combined paired Trial0 1168.864 / 1148.928 by 6.786 / 12.288 us. Aggregate measured a branch best 756.538 us despite unrelated n1024/n2048 variance, versus Trial2 757.058, row-wide Trial1 764.357, and combined Trial0 771.711.

Selected validated HEAD 567c77825171b887b203333946aafd649ad44118. The initial combine preserved every first-parent non-n512 specialization and imported direct-input stage-0 materialization, physical-upper FP32 diagonal reloads, and a compact 120-tile off-diagonal FP16 sidecar; it measured 771.711 us aggregate and batch640 n512 1168.864 us mean / 1148.928 best. Hosted index-5 profile request 4e8b5bb67759466cad03bd2862c4870f at 8e647a2 showed the first captured factor/solve/update waves at 42.430/212.840/455.000 us plus 142.020 us first-call zero fill; its report is preserved as profiles/2026-07-19-01-44-06-cholesky-resumed-local-unmerged/brief-93-trial-1-8e647a2b7a9f0b67538b5efa6bf671fb9d6dfb87.ncu-rep. One-CTA-per-row updates reduced repeated common-panel traffic but regressed the clean target floor to 1167.296 us. Four-destination CTAs restored parallelism while reusing one common factor and a 10.02-KiB accumulator/target workspace; exact full-grid repeats measured 757.058 then a branch-best 756.538 us, with target 1261.382/1138.656 then 1162.078/1136.640 us mean/best. The final commit passed slice build, all 17 official tests, the fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells. A final hosted profile was requested but denied because the hard rolling-hour fleet quota was occupied by Brief93 at 22:03, Brief94's reserved request, and Brief95 at 22:17; the earlier exact Brief93 profile remains available. If work resumes, concrete unmeasured openings include stage-selective four-wide versus paired update grouping, moving first-call lower-zero initialization out of the scored input identity, and three/five-wide sequential groups around the measured four-wide point.
